_meta.what_this_is: A curated map of which record classes are public by default in each jurisdiction, what each one discloses, and the documented suppression path. Compiled by hand before the build.
_meta.what_this_is_not: This performs NO lookups, NO scraping, and NO record retrieval. It tells you that a class of record about you is public and how to suppress it. It never fetches the record.
_meta.disclaimer: General information, not legal advice. Statutes and county procedures change; verify with your county clerk or assessor before relying on a suppression path.

property_deed.label: Property deeds and assessor records
property_deed.discloses: Your full name tied to a street address, purchase date, purchase price, and often a parcel map showing the lot.
property_deed.why_it_matters: This is the single most direct name-to-home-address link in public data, and it is indexed and resold by dozens of brokers.

voter_registration.label: Voter registration roll
voter_registration.discloses: Name, residential address, party affiliation in some states, year of birth, and voting history (that you voted, not how).
voter_registration.why_it_matters: Voter files are sold in bulk to campaigns and resold onward, which is how a home address ends up on a people-search site.

business_filing.label: Business registrations and UCC filings
business_filing.discloses: Registered agent name and address — which for a sole proprietor or small LLC is usually a home address.
business_filing.why_it_matters: Founders routinely register an LLC to their home address without realising the filing is fully public and searchable by name.

court_record.label: Court records and dockets
court_record.discloses: Name, case type, filing dates, and frequently an address of record. Family and small-claims filings are often the most sensitive.
court_record.why_it_matters: Court records are aggregated by commercial services and surface in background checks and search results indefinitely.

professional_license.label: Professional and occupational licenses
professional_license.discloses: Name, license number, license status, and the address of record — which is a home address unless a business address was supplied.
professional_license.why_it_matters: License lookup portals are designed for public verification, so they are trivially searchable by full name.

marriage_divorce.label: Marriage and divorce records
marriage_divorce.discloses: Both parties' full legal names, prior names, dates, and county of residence.
marriage_divorce.why_it_matters: Prior-name disclosure defeats a name change used for separation from a past relationship.

dmv_record.label: Motor vehicle records
dmv_record.discloses: Name and address tied to a vehicle and plate.
dmv_record.why_it_matters: Federally restricted, but the permissible-purpose list is broad enough that private investigators and insurers routinely obtain them.
dmv_record.federal_note: The Driver's Privacy Protection Act (18 U.S.C. §2721) restricts disclosure, but enumerates permissible purposes that many commercial requesters qualify for.

suppression_paths.path: Most states run an address-confidentiality program for survivors of domestic violence, stalking, sexual assault, or trafficking, and many also cover judges, prosecutors, and law enforcement. Enrolment substitutes a state-provided proxy address across public records.
Use a registered-agent service or a commercial mail address instead of your home address, then file an amendment to update the existing registration.
Most licensing boards let you nominate a business address of record. Change it in the board's portal.

The underlying records stay public, but the data brokers that aggregate and resell them all operate opt-out processes. Working the major-broker opt-out list is the highest-leverage action available to everyone.

TX.label: Texas
TX.notes: County appraisal district sites are individually searchable by owner name and are among the most accessible property records in the country.

suppression_paths.path: Texas Tax Code §25.025 lets qualifying individuals — including peace officers, judges, and victims of family violence — request that their address be withheld from public appraisal-district records. File with your county appraisal district.
The Texas Attorney General's Address Confidentiality Program provides a substitute address for survivors of family violence, sexual assault, stalking, or trafficking.
Texas Secretary of State filings are public. Use a registered-agent service and file a Statement of Change of Registered Office (Form 401).

TX.biometric_note: Texas CUBI (Bus. & Com. Code §503.001) requires informed consent before capturing a biometric identifier and mandates destruction within a reasonable time. This is why DDU Mirror puts face consent on its own screen with a visible destruction countdown.

WA.label: Washington
WA.notes: County assessor parcel search is public and name-searchable. Voter registration data is available to the public with some restrictions on commercial use.

suppression_paths.path: Washington's Address Confidentiality Program (RCW 40.24), run by the Secretary of State, provides a substitute address for survivors of domestic violence, sexual assault, trafficking, and stalking, and for criminal-justice participants.
RCW 29A.08.720 restricts commercial use of voter registration data and allows confidential status for ACP participants.
Use a registered-agent service and amend the filing through the Washington Secretary of State's Corporations portal.

WA.privacy_note: Washington's My Health My Data Act sets a high bar for consumer health data specifically, and signals the state's general direction on consent-first data handling.

CA.label: California
CA.notes: California voter files are NOT generally public — access is restricted to election, scholarly, journalistic, and political purposes under Elections Code §2194.

suppression_paths.path: California's Safe at Home program (Gov. Code §6205 et seq.) provides a substitute address for survivors of abuse, stalking, trafficking, and for reproductive healthcare workers.

The CCPA/CPRA gives California residents a right to deletion that data brokers must honour, and the DELETE Act (SB 362) requires registered brokers to process deletion requests through a single state mechanism.

IL.label: Illinois

suppression_paths.path: The Illinois Address Confidentiality Program (750 ILCS 61) provides a substitute address for survivors of domestic violence, sexual assault, stalking, and trafficking.

IL.biometric_note: Illinois BIPA (740 ILCS 14) is the strictest biometric statute in the country: written informed consent before collection, a published retention and destruction schedule, and a private right of action. Any face feature in this product must satisfy BIPA to be shippable in Illinois.

FL.label: Florida
FL.notes: Florida's Sunshine Law makes government records unusually open by default, and county property appraiser sites are among the easiest in the country to search by name.

suppression_paths.path: Florida Statute §119.071 exempts specific categories — law enforcement, judges, prosecutors, certain victims — from public disclosure of home address. Request the exemption from each agency holding the record.
Florida voter records are public, but the Address Confidentiality Program administered by the Attorney General provides a substitute address for eligible survivors.
New York's Address Confidentiality Program (Exec. Law §108) provides a substitute address for survivors of domestic violence, stalking, human trafficking, and sexual offences.
New York LLC formation historically required a published address. Use a registered-agent service and amend the Articles of Organization.

broker_opt_out.note: These aggregate public records into name-searchable profiles. Opting out does not change the underlying record, but it removes the easiest path to it. Each requires re-checking every few months — brokers repopulate.

tiers.description: Large aggregators that feed most downstream people-search sites. Opting out here reduces exposure across many smaller sites.
Consumer-facing name lookup sites. Individually low-effort, collectively time-consuming; each has its own opt-out form.
Derived from credit applications rather than public records. Handled through a separate process from public-record brokers.
